_comment: Analytics configuration. gtag.js loads when ga4MeasurementId OR adsConversionId is set. adsConversionId + labels created 2026-08-03 in the Google Ads account (Goals -> Conversions): adsRegistrationLabel = 'TPDM Registration' (PRIMARY, fired on registration-flow completion, what the Bartz campaign bids on); adsConversionLabel = 'TPDM Contact Form' (fired on contact-form submit). ga4MeasurementId stays empty until Checklist A in docs/marketing/setup-checklists.md is done.
